jobs.title: Customer Support (part-time)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

We’re looking for a personable and proactive customer support champion to help our users get the most out of Axle Energy’s products.

*This is a 6 month part-time contract role - perfect for someone that is ready to jump in and make an immediate impact.

What you will be doing

  • Act as the owner for complex or high-priority customer cases.

  • Collaborate closely with tech team to analyse and solve painpoints

  • Maintain and expand internal technical playbooks and knowledge resources.

  • Identify recurring customer issues bring insights to improve the product

You might be a good fit if you’re

  • Organized: you can stay on top of a to do list and constantly re-prioritize to make sure the most important stuff gets done

  • Empathetic: you care about other people’s problems, and you feel the pain when things don’t work as they should

  • Curious: you’re willing to dig in when things don’t work as they should, and keep an open mind when trying to debug issues

Benefits

A competitive salary & the opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office in Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 1-2 days a week in the office.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

Solutions Engineers at Axle build the integrations and technical infrastructure that enable our customers to connect distributed energy devices, orchestrate them, and participate in electricity markets.

This is a generalist engineering role, encompassing core software engineering, customer implementation, and solution design. You will work closely with our customers to understand their technical requirements, build integrations, solve complex technical challenges, and help shape our product based on real world feedback.

We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem space as they can. You will spend time talking to customers, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators, while collaborating with Product to deliver scalable engineering solutions.

At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone.

 

Solutions Engineering at Axle looks like

  • Forming a deep understanding of our domain, our platform, and our customers' technical challenges, so you have enough context to execute at speed.

  • Building and maintaining integrations with customer systems, distributed energy devices, and third-party platforms.

  • Working closely with customers to troubleshoot technical issues, support implementations, and design scalable solutions.

  • Steering customers towards a more direct launch plan and a better user experience.

  • Collaborating closely with our Product team to turn customer feedback into product improvements.

  • Focus on outcomes rather than process, taking ownership of the quality and impact of the final product you deliver.

  • Manage your own time and support others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, to deliver 80% of the value in 20% of the time

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, ideally building integrations or customer-facing technical solutions.

  • A track record of working directly with customers: scoping requirements, leading implementations, and owning the technical relationship.

Tech stack

🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend

🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility.
🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly

☁️ We deploy on GCP

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

 

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Remote pair programming

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we are looking for someone to help run and optimise the rhythms at the heart of the business.

We are looking for someone to develop a deep understanding of flexibility markets across the UK, who can collaborate cross-functionally, crunch numbers, and own critical daily and monthly operational processes.

Owning daily operations means sitting at the heart of the ‘Axle control room’. This involves running and optimising the most critical operations processes in the business: asset management, trading across UK flexibility markets, and ultimately ensuring our clients and end customers get paid for the flex they deliver.

A note on the job title: Analytics engineering is often closely associated with dbt. We don't use dbt at Axle because our data set up doesn't require a full ETL framework. Instead, this role is centred on the core analytics engineering skill set: developing a deep understanding of source data and building the data pipelines that power our analytics.

What you will be doing

  • Owning operations for our UK energy trading (e.g. daily trading processes, reviewing settlements)

  • Debugging complex edge cases across our trading, asset registration and settlement processes

  • Identifying risks to revenue and delivery and proactively mitigate them

  • Communicating insights and actions clearly to engineering and commercial teams

  • Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders in Distribution System Operators (DSOs) and UK market regulators

It would be great if you had

  • Strong SQL and Python skills for analysing data, investigating issues, and automating processes

  • Strong analytical skills: you’ll be speaking MW, kWh, and £ every day

  • A deep-seated motivation to combat climate change

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

We’re looking for our first product designer to level-up design throughout the company.

Axle is building cutting-edge energy products across the sector - from simple offerings for mass-market consumers, through to advanced tooling for early adopters and enthusiasts. We’re innovating to solve new and complex problems where there’s no established answers and where the customer experience is key.

We have a highly autonomous, flat structure, delivering our products in small interdisciplinary teams of engineers and PMs. We want to add a design voice as a pillar to this: understanding our users, leading our strategic direction, and ensuring the customer is always represented.

You’ll operate across the business to raise the quality of all our design output - through both direct delivery, as well as enablement and coaching of others.

  • Leading on our visual identity and finding new ways to tell Axle's story, through web, animation, and video

  • Working with global clients to help them to improve their user experiences

  • You're energised by ambiguity and take a pragmatic, outcome-first approach

  • You’re excited about bringing sophisticated technology to a broader audience and are happy to get into the technical details to do this

  • You’re deeply curious about the world and how people experience it

Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here https://www.axle.energy/blog/analysis/power-of-the-home.


ABOUT THE ROLE 

This role is for someone who can drive growth, generate demand, and build a repeatable marketing engine as Axle scales. You'll be our first Growth Marketing hire and be responsible for shaping our growth marketing strategy from the ground up, experimenting with channels, campaigns and messaging to find what works and scale it.

You’ll help Axle reach the right customers, bring our technology to market, and turn awareness into measurable commercial growth for our direct to consumer business.

We’re looking for someone who combines commercial instinct with analytical rigour and creative thinking. You’ll move quickly, take ownership, and work closely with our commercial, product and leadership teams to turn ambitious growth targets into results.




WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Building and executing targeted campaigns that reach priority audiences, generate qualified leads and contribute directly to user growth.

 - Developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and launch strategies for new propositions, markets and customer segments.

 - Testing and growing marketing channels, partnerships and campaigns to identify repeatable, cost-effective ways to acquire customers.

 - Translating complex energy and technology concepts into clear messaging and content that resonates with our target audiences.

 - Tracking acquisition, conversion and pipeline performance, using data and experimentation to improve marketing effectiveness and maximise commercial impact.

 - Manage our community engagement in social forums (e.g. Facebook groups, Reddit etc.)




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience in a B2C growth marketing role.

 - You're data-driven but practical. You run experiments and learn from the results, but also know when there isn’t enough data and you need to trust your judgement.

 - You use AI tools to work smarter across marketing, from researching audiences and analysing data to building reports, automating workflows and creating content.

 - You’re scrappy and hands-on. You test ideas quickly, find ways to make a budget go further and get stuck into whatever needs doing.

 - You’re comfortable building from scratch. This is our first growth marketing hire, so you’ll be shaping our approach, tools and processes as you go.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with product analytics tools such as PostHog.

 - Experience with paid social, referral programmes or community-led growth.




BENEFITS

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary. We operate with a deliberately flat structure. We aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bupa private healthcare from day one of employment.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office in Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.



We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Initial interview

 2. Take-home exercise

 3. Final interview (in-person)

 4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in French markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results in the French market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

  • Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

  • Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

  • Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

  • Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

  • Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Ideally, you would be able to start by February 2027.

Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

  2. Take-home exercise

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on product expert to collaborate closely with clients and engineers to identify opportunity and figure out what we need to build to accelerate growth and decarbonisation.

What you will be doing

  • Driving product–market fit including in new markets, ensuring customer needs and commercial objectives stay in sync.

  • Championing a customer-first mindset, translating feedback into impactful product solutions.

  • Overseeing end-to-end delivery - from scoping and defining success metrics to launch and iteration.

  • Designing user experiences that are clear, intuitive, and drive measurable impact

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of product management experience

  • Proven ownership of delivery: you've been responsible for something live in the real world, not only the strategy or concept around it

  • Experience building products that touch the physical world. You respect real-world complexity and design around things going wrong

  • Experience in B2B, B2B2C or data-heavy products, with comfort working across partners and end users

  • User research and discovery: you know how to speak to users and run discovery towards a clear goal

  • You identify pain points and needs, turn them into plans, and ensure delivery.

  • Comfortable with hands-on prototyping and design, at least to the level of high-fidelity concepts

Nice to have

  • Fluency in one or more European languages

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bupa private healthcare from day one of employment.

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!
